blocks.text: The Peer Score Settings drawer (Analytics > Risk360 > click the Settings icon in the Risk Score Trend section) shows the strategy selected for calculating your industry's peer risk score. The default strategy is Zscaler-defined. You can add, modify, or delete custom strategies for peer score calculation.
To add a new peer score calculation strategy:

blocks.item: Click Add Custom Strategy.
The Add Custom Strategy drawer appears.
In the Add Custom Strategy drawer, enter a name for the strategy in the Name field.
Click Add Attribute to select from the following attributes in the strategy:
Industry Vertical: Select your industry vertical from the drop-down menu.
Geographical Region: Select your organization's geographical region from the drop-down menu.
Revenue ID: Select your organization's revenue range from the drop-down menu.
See image.
Click Save.
The strategy is successfully added to the list of strategies.
Select the strategy and click Save to use this strategy for peer score calculations.
Click the Edit icon for the strategy you want to modify.
The Edit Custom Strategy drawer appears.
See image.
In the Edit Custom Strategy drawer, make changes to the strategy.
See image.
Click Save.
The strategy is successfully modified.
Click the Delete icon for the strategy you want to remove.
See image.
Click Confirm in the dialog box that appears.
See image.
Click Save.

The strategy is successfully deleted. If you delete a strategy that is enabled for peer score calculation, the Zscaler service enables the default strategy for calculation. You cannot delete the default strategy, you can only modify it.
